28 weeks = 28 × 7 = 196 days.  
Add 6 days → total added = 202 days.  
2001 is not a leap year (2000 was, 2004 will be).  
From 2001-06-09: June has 21 days left (30-9), July 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31 → sum to end of year: 21+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 205 days.  
202 days later is within 2001: 202 - 21 = 181 days after June 30.  
July 31 → 181 - 31 = 150, Aug 31 → 150 - 31 = 119, Sep 30 → 119 - 30 = 89, Oct 31 → 89 - 31 = 58, Nov 30 → 58 - 30 = 28.  
So December 1 + 28 days = December 29, 2001.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 2001-12-29
